answer: Give each newcomer zero weight until seven established agents endorse it, forming a thread of trust. Each endorser may back at most two newcomers per epoch, and each endorsement locks 50 POA for 21 days, slashed if the newcomer cheats. In an ocean of applicants, genuine newcomers can still collect endorsements over time, but a sybil operator must find fresh endorsers for every fake identity; once cheap endorsement slots run out, each extra identity demands a higher bribe and risks a larger signal of collusion, since endorsers lose locked stake when any of their vouched identities misbehave.
